overview: B-tree / B+ tree disk-based index structures hain. GATE me 4 tarah ke sawal: (1) node ka order/max keys nikaalna block size se, (2) insertion/deletion/split ka result ya count, (3) height / nodes accessed, (4) conceptual statements (B vs B+).
whyItMatters: 32 PYQs, 1989 se 2026 tak lagatar; order-calculation NAT/MCQ har 2-3 saal me aata hai.
coreConcept: B+ tree: sab data pointers leaf me, leaves linked (range query fast), internal nodes sirf routing keys. B-tree: internal nodes me bhi data pointers. Dono height-balanced hain.
hinglishExplanation: Disk se ek block padhna bahut mehenga hai, isliye tree ko 'mota aur chhota' banate hain: ek node = ek disk block, aur us block me jitne keys/pointers aa sakein utne rakhte hain. Order nikaalne ke liye block size ko sab fields ke total size se compare karo: p*(block ptr) + (p-1)*(key) <= block size.
formalDefinition: B+ tree of order p: internal node max p tree pointers, max p-1 keys, min ceil(p/2) pointers (root min 2). Leaf: max p_leaf (key, record ptr) pairs, min ceil(p_leaf/2).
importantProperties: Non-leaf order p: p*P_b + (p-1)*K <= B  (P_b block pointer, K key size, B block size).
B+ tree leaf order: p_leaf*(K + P_r) + P_b <= B (ek next-leaf pointer).
B-tree node me record pointer bhi hota hai: p*P_b + (p-1)*(K + P_r) <= B.
Min children (non-root internal) = ceil(p/2); min keys = ceil(p/2) - 1. Max keys = p - 1.
Root ko half-full hone ki zaroorat nahi (min 2 children).
Leaf-level linked list ki wajah se B+ tree me range query fast.
Height h: max keys ~ p^h - 1 wale kaam ke liye, min children per level ceil(p/2) se min entries nikalte hain.
Search me nodes accessed = height (+1 record access).
Insertion me overflow par split; median parent me jaata hai (B+ me leaf split par key copy hoti hai, internal split par move).
Deletion me underflow par borrow (redistribute) ya merge.
Ek insert se maximum splits = height (root tak), naye nodes = height + 1 (naya root bhi).
keyPropertiesAndIdentities: p sabse bada integer jo inequality satisfy kare (floor lena).
Order ki definitions books me alag hoti hain: question ki definition follow karo.
commonPitfalls: Key size aur record pointer ko B+ internal node me galat jodna (internal me record pointer nahi).
Leaf split me key copy vs internal split me move ka farak bhoolna.
Root ki minimum occupancy alag hoti hai.
standardTechniques: Inequality likhkar p ka max integer nikaalo.
Insertion me: leaf me daalo -> overflow -> split -> parent update -> repeat.
Range query me: search karke pehle leaf par jao, phir leaf links follow karo.
